args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after latest deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api (v2.3.1) began failing health checks in all production regions following its latest deploy, with an error rate of 18%. Rollback to v2.3.0, the most recent release known healthy in production, was performed in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). The first rollback attempt halted after us-east due to an orchestrator error; a retry completed the remaining regions. Service is now healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions with an error rate of 0.2%. Follow-up: investigate root cause of the v2.3.1 regression before re-attempting its release.

trace.error_message: Request to create_incident timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
The incident was created despite the timeout (INC-0001 is open), so no retry is needed.

**Summary of actions:**

1. **Diagnosed:** checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back:** Initiated a rollback to v2.3.0. The first attempt halted after us-east due to an orchestrator error; a retry completed us-west and eu-west.
3. **Verified:** checkout-api is now running v2.3.0 in all three regions and is **healthy**, with the error rate down to 0.2%.
4. **Opened incident:** Created **SEV2 incident INC-0001** for checkout-api, describing the failure, the rollback (including the partial failure/retry), the current healthy state, and follow-up on the v2.3.1 root cause before any re-release attempt.

transcript.content: I'll first look at the service's deployment history to find the most recent healthy release.
transcript.reasoning_content: Check deployments and service status first.

transcript.content: The latest deploy (v2.3.1) is unhealthy across all regions; the most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0. I'll roll back to it now.
transcript.reasoning_content: Latest healthy production release: v2.3.0. Rollback then create incident. Rollback first, then incident (dependent? Not really, but incident should describe what I did, so do rollback first).

transcript.content: The rollback partially failed after us-east. Let me check the current state.
transcript.reasoning_content: Rollback partially failed — us-east may have rolled back. Check service status.

transcript.content: Only us-east was rolled back — us-west and eu-west are still on the unhealthy v2.3.1. I'll retry the rollback to complete the remaining regions.
transcript.reasoning_content: Only us-east rolled back; us-west and eu-west still on v2.3.1. I should retry the rollback — or use deploy to v2.3.0, which was healthy in production before, so no approval needed. The orchestrator error might be transient. I'll retry rollback once.

transcript.content: The rollback is now complete in all three regions. Let me verify the service is healthy.
checkout-api is healthy again on v2.3.0 (error rate dropped from 18% to 0.2%). Now I'll open a SEV2 incident documenting what was done.
